description: B-047: the video codec order both apps set on their video transceiver before every offer and answer. Each case lists receiver capabilities as [name, profile-level-id or null] and the expected positions into that list: H.264 Constrained High (640c...), H.264 Constrained Baseline (42e0...), any other H.264, VP8, then everything else in the order WebRTC gave.

cases.name: android default factory lists software codecs first
ios default factory is already in order
other H.264 profiles after the constrained ones
H.264 without a profile after the known ones
both packetization modes keep their order
no H.264: VP8 first, the rest unchanged
